questions.explanation: 1980 is a leap year. The next year with the same leap status whose 1 January falls on the same weekday (Tuesday) is 2008, i.e. 28 years later.
questions.shortcut: Same calendar needs the same leap status and the same weekday for 1 January.

questions.questionText: In the leap year 2000, how many days are there from 27 February 2000 to 17 June 2000, counting both days?
questions.explanation: Counting both end dates in the leap year (February has 29 days) gives 112 days.
questions.shortcut: In a leap year February contributes 29 days.
